question: A 100-mm prick punch with a 7-mm diameter body could have a 2.5-mm diameter point ground to an angle of __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __30°__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A prick punch is a small diameter punch used to create reference marks on metal surfaces.
 
• The point of the prick punch is ground to a specific angle to ensure precise marking and effective usage.
 
• The angle of the point determines the sharpness and suitability for specific marking tasks.
 
• For a 2.5-mm diameter point, a 30° angle is ideal for creating accurate and fine marks.
 
• This angle ensures better penetration and reduces the risk of slipping during marking.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uses of Prick Punch:**

 
 
• Prick punches are used for making precise points for drilling or machining.
 
• They help in transferring measurements and layouts onto metal surfaces.
 
 
 
• **Difference Between Prick Punch and Center Punch:**
 
 
• A prick punch has a sharper angle (e.g., 30°), while a center punch has a wider angle (e.g., 90°).
 
• Prick punches are used for light marking, whereas center punches are used for heavier indentations.
